teaser.en: A small wild legume of the indigo genus, known to Digo people by the look of its leaves.
teaser.sw: Mmea mdogo wa porini wa jamii ya kunde, wa jenasi ya mnili, unaojulikana na Wadigo kwa sura ya majani yake.
teaser.dg: Mmea mdide wa weruni wa jamii ya kunde, wa jenasi ya *Indigofera*, unaomanyikana ni Adigo kpwa umbo ra makodzage.

summary.en: Lihago is a herb of the genus Indigofera, the indigo plants, which Pakia identified only to genus. Digo people recognise it by its leaves.
summary.sw: Lihago ni mmea mdogo wa jenasi Indigofera, jenasi ya mnili, ambao Pakia aliutambua hadi kiwango cha jenasi tu. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
summary.dg: *Lihago* ni mmea mdide wa jenasi ya *Indigofera*, mimea ya *indigo*, na Pakia anaandika jenasiye tu. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

about.en: Lihago is a herbaceous member of the pea family in the genus *Indigofera*. Plants of this genus usually have pinnate or three-parted leaves. Their stems and leaves carry fine hairs attached at the middle, lying flat like tiny staples. The small pea-flowers are pink to brick-red, in slender spikes, and are followed by narrow straight or slightly curved pods. Pakia collected lihago only to genus, so its species is not known. Digo people pick it out by the look of its leaves.
about.sw: Lihago ni mmea mdogo laini wa familia ya kunde katika jenasi *Indigofera*. Mimea ya jenasi hii kwa kawaida ina majani ya mchanganyiko au yenye sehemu tatu. Mashina na majani yake yana vinywele vyembamba vilivyoshikizwa katikati, vilivyolala bapa kama pini ndogo za stapla. Maua madogo ya umbo la ua la njegere ni ya waridi hadi rangi ya tofali, katika masuke membamba, na hufuatwa na maganda membamba yaliyonyooka au yaliyopinda kidogo. Pakia aliukusanya lihago hadi kiwango cha jenasi tu, kwa hivyo spishi yake haijulikani. Wadigo huutambua kwa sura ya majani yake.
about.dg: *Lihago* ni mmea laini wa jamii ya kunde, wa jenasi ya *Indigofera*. Mimea ya jenasi ihi kpwa kawaida ina makodza ganayoganywa kukala makodza madide manji, au mahahu. Mihi na makodza gana nyere ndide sana zirizogbwirira kahi-kahi, zinazolala sambamba dza visumari vidide (*staples*). Maruwa madide dza ga kunde ni ga pinki hadi ga kundu dza tofali, ganamera dzulu ya milita myembamba, na badaye kunazuka makakaya membamba, ganayokala sawa au ganayofyuka chidide. Pakia wahala *lihago* na kumanya jenasiye tu, kpwa hivyo ainaye taimanyikana. Adigo anaumanya kpwa umbo ra makodzage.

where.en: *Indigofera* herbs are common in grassland, bush, fallow fields and roadsides along the coast.
where.sw: Mimea midogo ya *Indigofera* hupatikana sana katika nyika za nyasi, vichakani, mashamba yaliyoachwa na kando ya barabara pwani.
where.dg: Mimea midide ya *Indigofera* ni ya kawaida kpwenye mavuwe, weruni, minda iriyorichwa na kanda-kanda ya njira, pwani yosi.

names.en: Digo: *lihago*. Pakia records it only for Digo and gives no meaning or English or Swahili name. The genus takes its name from indigo, the blue dye obtained from *Indigofera tinctoria*. Another *Indigofera*, *I. trita*, is *chibugu chilume*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *lihago*. Pakia anaurekodi kwa Kidigo tu na hatoi maana yake wala jina la Kiingereza au la Kiswahili. Jenasi hii imepata jina lake kutokana na nili (indigo), rangi ya buluu inayopatikana kutoka *Indigofera tinctoria*. *Indigofera* mwingine, *I. trita*, ni *chibugu chilume*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *lihago*. Pakia anaandika dzina hiri kpwa Chidigo tu, na kaandika manage wala dzina ra Chingereza au ra Chiswahili. Dzina ra jenasi rinalavywa kula *indigo*, rangi ya samawati inayolavywa kula *Indigofera tinctoria*. *Indigofera* yanjina, *I. trita*, ni *chibugu chilume*.
